package.name: kontrolem_gz
package.description: Kontrol'Em v2 Gazebo-native hardware: GzBaseStateSystem, a gz_ros2_control hardware component that reads a floating base's ground-truth pose/twist directly from Gazebo's entity-component manager and exports it (plus constant all-stance contact) as the floating_base/contact scalar state interfaces, so the in-gz controller_manager can feed non-joint base state to a whole-body controller alongside IgnitionSystem's joints. Isolates the heavy Gazebo build deps here.
